description: Design a pure LAN PC remote control software with extremely low latency, lossless image quality, and minimalist UI

userStories.title: Design low-latency LAN network protocol
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to design a custom UDP-based network protocol optimized for low latency and reliability on LAN.
acceptanceCriteria: Create docs/NETWORK_PROTOCOL.md
Define message types (control commands, screen frames, ACKs, heartbeats)

Document TOS/QoS settings for low delay
Documentation files created and properly formatted
userStories.notes: Completed: Created docs/NETWORK_PROTOCOL.md with UDP-based protocol design, message types, sequence/ACK mechanism, and TOS/QoS settings.

userStories.title: Design screen capture and lossless/low-latency encoding module

acceptanceCriteria: Create docs/SCREEN_CAPTURE_AND_ENCODING.md

Define delta frame detection algorithm
Define compression strategy (e.g., LZ4 for raw delta or low-delay H.264)
Documentation files created and properly formatted
userStories.notes: Completed: Created docs/SCREEN_CAPTURE_AND_ENCODING.md with OS-specific screen capture APIs (DXGI, ScreenCaptureKit, X11/Wayland), delta frame detection algorithm, and compression strategy (LZ4 for raw delta, Low-Delay H.264/AV1).
